mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which is a precursor to economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent decline in retail sales over three consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a high level of nonfarm payrolls (above 150,000) signals a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in retail sales signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a combination of rising CPI and stable or decreasing federal funds rate signals inflation without corresponding monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases while FEDFUNDS is stable or decreases
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where a decline in GDP during a period of high inflation (CPI > 5%) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
